limitations: mcp__codex_apps__marketdata app connector returned oauth_token_invalid_grant and requires reauthentication; no token was printed or used in shell.
Article avoids exact intraday entry levels for NVDA, CRWD and CRM because live post-open prices were not refreshed through the app connector.
Post-earnings stock reaction wording is framed as initial/after-hours reaction where sources differed during live coverage.

Pre-market percentage moves came from MCP marketdata output supplied in-thread; direct live app connector remained unauthenticated, while direct MCP WatchlistDigest was used for current signal/earnings-date confirmation.
This revision intentionally preserves the original pre-earnings thesis architecture and turns it into a post-earnings chain review rather than a generic NVDA/CRWD/CRM recap.
The secondary watchlist is framed as a public, transposable map, not as disclosure of private positions or account exposure.
Setup buckets are pre-open only; final confirmation requires regular-market 15-minute bars with real volume, VWAP and opening-range behavior.
Broker/account-specific notes from the source audit were deliberately excluded from the public article.
Crypto/gold high-beta names are framed as factor-confirmation watches, not as direct buy recommendations.
OKTA earnings figures were added in the final scorecard pass to avoid treating OKTA only as a price reaction.
Contrarian review says PASS WITH CONDITIONS: refresh regular-session 15-minute bars before publishing after the open.
Retail war-room review says PASS BUT DENSE: acceptable as tactical map, long for a quick retail note.
